footprints.description: Same Sky SD-4-B SD card socket (push-push, SMD right angle), 11 contacts + 4 shell pads
footprints.note: sd-4-b.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB Layout (top view, card enters from the bottom of the drawing; rotated 180 deg about the housing centre so the opening points up). Contact pads 1.00 x 1.80 (pins 10 and 11: 0.70 x 1.80), all 1.80 high with their inner edge on the housing back edge; x from the card centre line: pin 9 +9.375 (printed 9.375), pins 7..1 at pitch 2.50 from pin 9 -17.50 (printed 17.50, 2.50): pin 7 = 9.375-17.50 = -8.125, pin 1 = -8.125+15.00 = 6.875; pin 8 = pin 7 -1.63 = -9.755, pin 10 = pin 8 -1.30 = -11.055, pin 11 = pin 10 -1.20 = -12.255 (1.63 printed on p.2; 1.30 and 1.20 printed on p.3, read from the drawing, checked to 0.03 mm against the rendered print). Holes: dia 1.10 at -11.50 (11.50 from the centre line) and dia 1.60 at 9.50 (21.00 between them), both 2.05 below the pad row (2.05 printed), non-plated. Shell pads 1.50 x 2.80: bottom pair at +-13.65 (28.80 overall, 14.40 to the centre line, 1.50 wide), y 14.25..17.05 (14.60 from the top pad edge -0.35, 2.80 high; 14.25 = -0.35+14.60); top pair: left 13.64 left of the centre line, right 11.44 right (26.57 overall between their outer edges: 13.64+0.75+11.44+0.75 = 26.58; centres measured from the print, +-0.03 mm), y -0.35..2.45 (2.40 above the hole line +0.40). Body = housing 26.30 wide (p.2) by 16.50 deep (p.2, 16.50), back edge on the pad row inner edge (the front line drawn on p.3 is 16.59 from it: 16.50 used).

footprints.description: Same Sky SD-5-B SD card socket (SMD right angle, through-hole shell legs), 11 contacts + 4 shell legs
footprints.note: sd-5-b.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB Layout (top view, card enters from the bottom; rotated 180 deg about the housing centre so the opening points up). Scale of the vector print 8.163 pt/mm (2.15 pitch = 17.55 pt). Contact pads 1.30 x 1.50 (11-1.30, 1.50), pitch 2.15 (2.15x10 = 21.50), pad P4 on the connector centre line; order left to right W/P(10) P8 P7 P6 P5 P4 P3 CD(11) P2 P1 P9, i.e. x = (k-5) x 2.15, k = 0..10. Shell legs: 4 plated slots 0.55 x 1.50 (4-0.55, 4-1.50) at x = +-14.63 (29.26 between slot centres), y 5.69 below the pad top edge (5.69) and 7.85 further (7.85): 5.69 and 13.54. Each leg pad is 1.54 wide (1.54) and 2.10 long (4-2.10) with a 1.70 tall rectangular tail towards the housing (4-1.70); the slot is 0.577 from the outer edge, so it is drawn as two abutting pads of pin 12 (pads of one pin may not overlap): a pad centred on the slot 1.154 x 2.10 (2 x 0.577) and, on the housing side, the rest of the tail 0.381 x 1.70 from 0.587 to 0.968 from the slot centre (1.54 = 0.577+0.968; centre 0.7775; 0.01 clear of the slot pad); the print's tail is 0.693 wide starting 0.274 from the slot centre, the 0.30 under the slot pad is the slot pad. The rounded outer end of the print is square here. Body: housing outline 27.32 wide (27.32) and 14.26 deep (451.44 to 567.83 pt = 116.39 pt / 8.163), back edge 1.80 below the pad top edge (0.30 beyond the pads).

Shell pads 1.80 x 2.20 (1.80, 2.20) at x +-14.825 (29.65 between), y 3.80 (3.80) and 23.90 (23.90) below the hole line, which is 1.90 (1.90) below the pad edge: 5.70 and 25.80 below the pad edge. footprints.description: Same Sky SIM-1-A SIM card socket (SMD right angle), 8 contacts + 2 unnumbered side pads
footprints.note: sim-1-a.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB Layout (top view, card enters from the bottom; rotated 180 deg about the outline centre so the opening points up). Vector print, 7.795 pt/mm (7-1.27 pitch = 9.91 pt; 8-1.00 pad width = 7.79 pt). Contact pads 1.00 x 2.30 (8-1.00, 8-2.30), pitch 1.27 (7-1.27), left to right of the print CD2 (pin 8), CD1 (7), C7 (6), C3 (3), C6 (5), C2 (2), C5 (4), C1 (1); pin = the table order VCC C1, RST C2, CLK C3, GND C5, VPP C6, I/O C7, CD1, CD2. Two hatched (SMT solder area) side pads 1.50 x 2.95 (2-1.50, 2-2.95), 20.55 between their centres (20.55), the pinout has no shield pin so they are unnumbered (pin 0). The cross-hatched copper-restricted areas are not pads and are not drawn. Body = the dashed outline of the print: 19.37 wide (959.5 to 1588.5 px at 300 dpi = 150.96 pt), bottom edge 25.95 below the pad centre line (8-25.95), top edge at the higher shoulder (377.3 pt), 26.50 high (206.6 pt / 7.795; read from the print, the left shoulder of the notched outline is 0.85 lower).

Two hatched side pads 1.50 x 3.20 (2-1.50, 2-3.20), 19.28 between centres (19.28), unnumbered (the pinout has no shield pin). The cross-hatched copper-restricted areas are not pads and are not drawn. footprints.description: Same Sky SD7-6-A SD 7.0 card socket (SMD right angle), 20 contacts + 7 shell pads

Vector print, 7.571 pt/mm (20.50 between the holes = 155.2 pt, 27.10 = 205.2 pt). Top row: 11 contact pads 0.80 x 1.80 (11-0.80), pitch 1.40 (1.40), left to right #9, #1, #2, #3, #4, [GND pad], #5, CD, #6, #7, #8, WP; the print gives 6.825 from the centre line to #9 and 8.675 to WP (15.50 between), so x from the centre line: #9 -6.825, #1 -5.425, #2 -4.025, #3 -2.625, #4 -1.225, #5 +1.675, CD +3.075, #6 +4.475, #7 +5.875, #8 +7.275, WP +8.675. Pin = # number, CD = pin 19, WP = pin 20. Lower pads 1.60 x 0.80 (9-1.60, 9-0.80): left group #10, #11, #12, #13 and right group #18, #17, #16, #15, #14 from the top of the print down, pitch 1.10 (8.33 pt). Shell pads (pin 21, GND): top-centre 1.40 x 1.70 (0.225 right of the centre line, 0.225), top-left and top-right 1.60 x 1.70 (2-1.60), and four more 1.70 x 1.60 (mid-left, mid-right, lower-left, lower-right), all read from the pad outlines in pt / 7.571 (the print prints 4-1.40, 2-1.60, 5-1.40, 3-1.50 without saying which pad). Holes 2 x dia 0.90 (2-dia0.90), 20.50 and 27.10 apart, taken as non-plated (the print does not say). The 11-0.85 etc. keep-out is not drawn. Body = the dashed keep-out outline, 31.70 wide (31.70 ref.) x 31.40 high (31.40 ref.), centred on its measured centre.

footprints.description: Same Sky SD4-3-B SD 4.0 (UHS-II) card socket (SMD right angle), 19 contacts + 4 shell pads

Pin numbers: the print's #n is pin n (the pinout lists SD pin numbers 1..17), CD is pin 18 and WP pin 19. x from the centre line (middle of the shell pads): WP -8.60, #8 -7.20, #7 -5.81, #6 -4.41, CD -3.01, #5 -1.62 | #4 +2.53, #3 +3.93, #2 +5.32, #1 +6.72, #9 +8.13 (read from the pad outlines / 3.263; the print gives 2.30/1.40/4.625/3.375 pad-edge stacks without a single pad list). Shell pads 1.60 x 1.50 (4-1.60, 1.50) at x +-13.45 (28.40 overall), y: upper 5.16 and lower 24.29 below the top-row pad outer edge (pad outlines / 3.263). Holes 2 x dia 0.90 (+0.10/-0) at x -12.20 and +11.87 (measured; the print is not symmetric about the centre line), 20.00 apart in y, non-plated. The cross-hatched glue / no-copper areas are not drawn. Body = housing 25.60 wide (p.2) x 21.70 deep (p.2 prints 23.35 from the lead tips, the leads project 1.65), back edge 1.85 below the top-row pad outer edge (pad outer edge + 0.20 lead overhang + 1.65): this offset is an assumption.
